method: Pythia source-pinned zero-shot stability prediction (Sun et al. 2025)

selection.threshold: strict score < -2 on frozen primary aggregation
selection.rule: best nonidentity substitution per eligible position

grid: 19 alternative amino acids per eligible residue
coverage: all supported coordinate positions; missing coordinates unscored
historical_uncertainties: Paper mapping of summed vs mean score not fully explicit; both retained as distinct libraries.
